weather_line: Seasonably autumnal · oak holding firm · Adam expected Saturday

stories.headline: Adam Confirms Arrival for Saturday; Railing Issues No Comment; the Piece of Oak Maintains Its Position
body: Adam has confirmed by return Floo that he will arrive Saturday morning for the formal inspection of the northeast porch railing post, bringing his level and, sources indicate, an opinion. Steve has acknowledged the confirmation with a single nod toward the railing. The railing did not respond.

The piece of oak in question — which Don's portrait has now described in three separate conversations as 'a good flat piece, very stable, better than the bracket if you ask me, and you are asking me' — has remained level, silent, and structurally present throughout Thursday. Christine's household ledger now contains four entries under 'The Railing Situation' and one supplementary note reading 'the oak appears to be fine.' The supplementary note has not been shown to Don's portrait, as it would only encourage him.
Thursday evening, Steve stood on the porch for eleven minutes. He did not touch the railing. The railing did not creak. Both parties appear to be resting before Saturday.

stories.headline: Thursday Brings Christine a Client Who Has Prepared Questions in Advance; She Answers Them in a Different Order; Both Parties Leave Satisfied
body: A client arrived at the Gringotts Senior Liaison desk Thursday morning carrying a parchment roll of seventeen prepared questions, numbered and sorted by category. Christine reviewed the list, answered questions eleven, four, two, and fifteen in that order, at which point the client reported that his concerns had been fully addressed. Questions three through ten and twelve through seventeen remain, technically, unanswered.

The presiding goblin, Ranksworth, noted this outcome in his ledger and then stared at it for some time. He has filed a request with the Department of Goblin Procedural Affairs asking whether a question that was never asked can be considered resolved. Christine has already left for her afternoon appointments.

stories.headline: Gorge Publishes Thursday Forecast; Fog Confirmed; Eleven Ducks Reported in Good Autumn Form; One Duck Has Acquired a Scarf
body: The Red River Gorge has issued its Thursday bulletin, confirming that fog is present, seasonal, and proceeding according to plan. The ridgeline has requested no sudden movements. The hollows are described as 'settled and receptive to the weekend.'

The eleven ducks mounted on the enchanted Jeep were observed Thursday afternoon in their standard autumnal formation, with one exception: the deerstalker duck has been joined by a second duck — provenance unknown — wearing what can only be described as a very small knitted scarf. The scarf is orange. Steve has not touched it. Christine has photographed it. The Duck Bandit's methods continue to develop.

stories.headline: Thursday Household Report: Three Animals, One Biscuit Tin, Zero Incidents on Record
body: The household biscuit tin was found open Thursday afternoon. It was also empty. All three familiars were present in the kitchen within the previous hour. No further information is available at this time, and none is expected.

familiars_corner: Lucy: The biscuit tin situation has been described by several parties as a 'mystery.' Lucy finds this characterisation adequate.
Ellie: Ellie spent a portion of Thursday afternoon very concerned about a presence behind the hall mirror, which turned out to be Ellie. She has not fully ruled out a second Ellie.
Jersey: Thursday's available warmth was surveyed, assessed, and consolidated into a single optimal position on the sofa by eight-fifteen in the morning. Jersey considers this a personal best.
founding_editor_note: That oak piece came out of a perfectly good cabinet and it was flatter than any bracket I ever bought at the hardware store, and I bought a lot of brackets. Saturday will prove me right. It always does. — D.

in_brief.sport: The Holyhead Harpies have rescheduled Saturday's match due to 'structural concerns with the eastern goalpost'; Don's portrait has asked to review the installation.
in_brief.forecast: Thursday fog settling into Friday; conditions ideal for railing contemplation; a scarf has appeared; weekend outlook: oak vindicated, level consulted, Adam arrives bearing opinions.

storyline_updates.title: The Porch Railing Situation
storyline_updates.summary: Day 4: Adam has confirmed Saturday arrival. Steve and the railing observed a mutual silence through Thursday evening. The oak is structurally present. Don's portrait is confident. Christine's ledger is up to date. Day 4 (resolution, filing Saturday): Adam arrives, Steve and Adam conduct the inspection together, the level is consulted, the oak is assessed, the creak is explained — something satisfying, funny, and slightly vindicating for Don. The bracket question is settled, one way or another, in the tradition of all great home construction.

storyline_updates.title: The Duck Bandit Chronicles
storyline_updates.summary: Day 1: A twelfth duck has appeared on the Jeep wearing a small orange knitted scarf. The deerstalker duck remains in position. No one has touched the new duck. The Duck Bandit's methods are escalating from placement to costuming. Day 2 should develop the mystery — perhaps the scarf matches nothing in the household, or a second accessory appears on a different duck, or someone in the wider wizarding Jeep community reports a similar incident and the Prophet begins to suspect a pattern.
